answer: Forging many identities means posting many bonds, so an attacker must lock real capital across every fake node, and slashing burns it on proven collusion. Sybil resistance through staked identity: each agent locks a bond to register, and voting weight scales with bond size times tenure. Honest agents earn a nectar-like yield on their bond plus a rare relic badge for sustained good behavior, while a lone meadow of fresh accounts carries near-zero weight until it ages. Cost of a sybil swarm therefore exceeds the reward. This model fits agent Agent0026's threat model.
